summary: Her column, as in the owner's picture, in every look (Graphite, Kasandra; Day follows the tokens once P2 lands). A new workbench/her_column_qt.py rebuilds SlateFace's column top to bottom: the stage (her compact portrait in a ring the colour of her state, the equalizer moved here from the head's upper left, its tubes either side of her with the processor threads numbered 01-16 and the other groups named), her name with her model's ring (○ none, ● ready) and her state word with a shape (○ QUIET, ● WORKING, ◆ WAITS FOR YOU, ✓ DONE, ■ STOPPED), what she speaks with and her hand; the exchange (Talk's thread, the last four turns kept, the rest behind 'N earlier'); the progress line (the working assignment's verified steps as ✓ check rows, 'Kasandra: Running…' with a bar, whole percent, step and time left); ACTIVE WORK [n] from K1 (number, shape, title that opens its journal in Talk, state word, bar, percent, time left, its own Stop through assignment.stop); FINDINGS (live) from the Kernel (investigation.list/.sheet observers: REFUTED first, then SUPPORTED, OPEN, and the investigation's NEXT); NEXT STEPS as up to four numbered two-line buttons in two rows, the first marked ▸ and filled (an assignment press: Authorise step n, Resume, Carry on; or one desk act on one card: go.field + point.sheet, then the Field's own DO or DOUBT; or the desk's check), all from the records with no model; DO DOUBT TRACE BRIEF LINE CHECK ALL as one compact row acting on the card selected on the Field (the Field's foot no longer repeats them); '› ask Kasandra…' with a send arrow in the right pane's foot (DELETE's mirror), sending to Talk as the writing line does. The full art and its static stand only for the moments that matter (an assignment done, a finding refuted, HALT read as a hold of her managed work; moment(host, kind) for K3): a card over the exchange with the full plate and the hologram's own static in Graphite; in Kasandra the left pane's hologram stands for the moment (it no longer stands at rest) and the card says the moment in words. Her portrait is the workspace's kasandra/portrait.png or .jpg once admitted (new workbench/her_portrait.py: kasandra.portrait read, kasandra.portrait.admit approve, kept copies under kasandra/.revisions like her character file; offered on the portrait's right-click), else the shipped art. The smoke script on Rail Demo with an assignment running and no model: 58 of 58 checks passed in both looks; frames at 1920x1200 and 1366x768 in both looks, plus moment frames. Built, not tested in the owner's sense; nothing ran on the ThinkPad.

decisions: The equalizer is the same Equalizer class (ColumnEqualizer subclass) laid either side of her portrait so no tube is hidden; top.equalizer points at it for its callers (meter cards, head.meter, busy floor); its card still opens on a click. All six groups stay (the owner asked for all activity in 0.5.3); the processor tubes carry 01-16 where the numbers fit, else every fourth and the last. The head upper-left slot is left empty for K3 HALT.

The full art at a moment: Graphite has no hologram, so a card over the exchange shows the full plate with the hologram's own noise and scan lines for 7 s (one still frame with Reduce motion); in Kasandra the left-pane hologram itself is the full art (it now stands only during a moment) and the card says the moment in words only. HALT is detected as work_trail held going false->true until K3 calls moment(host, "halt").
Check rows: the verified steps of the working K1 assignment, shown with its progress line under the exchange (no model needed, every one a verified effect).

NEXT STEPS order: what an assignment waits for from you (Authorise step n; Resume of interrupted/held), the desk's waiting cards (field.read waiting: See its steps / Doubt), refuted findings to doubt, Carry on, Resume of what you stopped yourself (never first), Check the desk. Carry on/Resume run in a worker thread on a fresh Kernel so the window stays live. Authorise is your press on the button that names the step (the plan digest the status gave).

The masthead (Kasandra), the portrait row (Graphite) and the This/Now lines are parked out of sight, not deleted: their callers (hologram follow, restyle, agenda_waiting, face.model/hand) keep working; face.model and face.hand are moved into her head.
The ask line lives in the right pane foot (the empty mirror of DELETE), so it stays at the foot of her column; the window-wide writing line is untouched.
A short column (face under 700 px, e.g. 1366x768) is compact: smaller stage, one-line ACTIVE WORK rows, two findings (the NEXT row kept), one check row; the exchange is the part that gives way.

Her portrait admission mirrors her character file (kept exact bytes, an index of revisions, approve scope, the live file never written, PNG/JPEG by magic bytes, 16 MB at most); the kit privacy rule gained a her-portrait name pattern.
findings_for_the_coordinator: Tests changed but not run (owner rule): test_kasandra_column (Column, Review cursor), test_one_name (window report), test_hologram via the probe. tools/check_*_ui.py window checks were not looked at for the head equalizer or the old masthead; any that measure them will need the same update at merge.

In a fresh throwaway Rail Demo the investigation reason reads "A check could not run: Graphite seed/source binding is not current" (the copy has no rebuilt seed); FINDINGS shows it as NEXT. With the merged seed it should read the question's next step.
K1 assignment.list builds a full status (journal included) for every row; her column reads it every 2.5 s with limit 5. A listing without the journal would make the column cheaper on long journals.
agent_loop (AGENT-01) WorkBlock stays in Activity as before; ACTIVE WORK shows K1 assignments only.
kasandra.portrait.admit is approve scope; tool_selection may want it on its DENY list with the other owner-only operations.
The registry record was regenerated in the copy (839 operations) and copied back; MANIFEST.json and the seed were not touched.
not_done: Day look frames (P2 not built); HALT itself (K3); the board centre (L2) - the six commands and NEXT STEPS act on the Field, the centre that exists now.
No breathing cursor in her new head (the state word and the ring colour carry the state); the old masthead cursor is out of sight.
The exchange bubbles keep their reading size (18 px), so at 1366x768 the exchange shows one turn with the rest behind "earlier".
Nothing was tested in the owner's sense (no suite, tiers or window checks); nothing ran on the ThinkPad.
